name: Kyojin-tachi
source:
High school Fukurasuzume is one of the prefecture's most advanced schools. Ruled by principles of rigorism, it puts the students' discipline first. If a perfect high school exists, it must be it. As now almost everyone goes to uni, it is difficult for schools to stand out. Yet, it being so classy, everyone wanted to enter Fukurasuzume and not some other high school. It didn't become such a place out of the blue, though. In it, a secret organization handles all the misconducts of both internal and external parties. And it has a name  - Chemie club. They deal with everything, starting from shoplifting and deplorable acts of theft to deaths, homicides, and disappearances before the police so much as catches wind of the fact anything happened. Yeah, that chemistry club is that influential. Don't ask me. I have no idea why that's the case; I'm just your regular investigator and all. 

At the tender age of 18, he is an undercover investigator and the head of the Second Investigative Security Division of the Chemie club. As is appropriate for his age, he goes to school as a regular student and is tasked with preventing different trivial and not so trivial incidents. 

However, one fall, our hero embarks on yet another investigation. That's when the story begins in earnest.

Our protagonist advances the story. It leads him to the truth behind the crime. However, he feels as if something isn't quite right. Why? Honestly, he has no idea. But he has thoughts in his head he himself doesn't quite understand. That's when our protagonist notices what this case is really about and the poison contained in it.
translation:
Fukurasuzume高中是县内最先进的学校之一。它遵循严格的原则，将学生的纪律放在第一位。如果存在一所完美的高中，那一定就是它了。现在几乎每个人都上大学，学校很难脱颖而出。然而，由于它是如此优雅，所以每个人都想进入福留诘而不是其他高中。不过，它并没有突然变成这样一个地方。其中，有一个秘密组织处理内部和外部各方的所有不当行为。它有一个名字——化学俱乐部。他们处理一切事情，从入店行窃和可悲的盗窃行为，到警察面前的死亡、凶杀和失踪，甚至听到任何发生的事情的风声。是的，那个化学俱乐部很有影响力。别问我。我不知道为什么会这样；我只是你的普通调查员而已。

年仅18岁的他是一名卧底调查员，也是化学俱乐部第二调查安全部的负责人。由于适合他的年龄，他作为一名普通学生上学，并肩负着防止各种琐碎和不那么琐碎的事件的任务。

然而，一年秋天，我们的英雄开始了另一项调查。这就是故事真正开始的时候。

我们的主角推动了故事的发展。这引导他了解犯罪背后的真相。不过，他感觉好像有什么地方不太对劲。为什么？老实说，他不知道。但他脑子里却有一些连他自己都不太明白的想法。就在那时，我们的主角注意到了这个案件的真正含义以及其中所含的毒药。
